mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id AS id, name, email, phone, status, role, created_at FROM MEMBER WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT member_id, login_id AS id, name, email, phone, zipcode, address1, address2, role, status, suspend_reason, created_at FROM MEMBER WHERE member_id = #{member_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET status = #{status}, role = #{role}, suspend_reason = #{suspend_reason}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{member_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( login_id, password, name, email, phone, zipcode, address1, address2, role, status ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{zipcode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, 'STAFF', 'ACTIVE' )
